response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile hands-on engineer with roughly 15+ years of professional experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems, plus founder experience with an open-source geo-data platform. However, this role is a director-level IC focused on AI strategy, requiring recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products/platforms, and deep cloud platform fluency paired with customer/partner advisory and organizational influence. His resume shows only recent, peripheral AI exposure (MCP tooling and agent infrastructure), limited cloud-platform depth (some AWS CDK, Kubernetes), and no evidence of strategy work, executive-level advisory, or technical leadership at the scale expected. Title trajectory has remained senior/staff IC rather than principal or distinguished level.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across many stacks and domains
Founder of an open-source platform; strong community teaching and talks
Proven low-latency, high-scale systems and DevOps/CI experience
concerns: Minimal demonstrated AI/ML expertise or shipped AI products
No director-level scope, strategy, or customer/partner advisory experience
Limited cloud-platform depth for a cloud/AI strategy role

key_factors.factor: Seniority/scope vs. director-level IC strategy role
Depth and breadth of engineering experience (15+ years, founder)
